caption: The drawing depicts a lidded sugar bowl standing on a square base. The bowl is tall and urn-shaped, with a broad, rounded body that tapers to a narrow stem before flaring out again into the base. It has a detailed lid with a finial at the top. The sugar bowl is rendered in shades of gray, suggesting a metallic material, with highlights and shading indicating reflections on its surface. There is a decorative monogram or design on the front of the bowl. The background consists of a plain, light beige or tan color, with the bowl centered in the composition. In the bottom right corner, handwritten text states “SUGAR BOWL ABOUT 9" TALL CASE 2 13519-1.” Another handwritten note in the lower left corner reads “Joseph Lisrit.” The drawing is neatly framed by a faint pencil border.
title: Sugar Bowl
